body:
Finite bit-supplier construction; no new kappa. Replace the selected PR589 R439 word's phase-B frame-519 block `B[163:205]` with two exact integer-map schedules using **16 + 16 rather than 19 + 23 ADDs**. Rebuilding its required literal reverse cleanup saves another ten ADDs: the complete local stream falls **24,305 → 24,285**.

The twelve source registers and all 661 frame paths are preserved. No helper, COPY, MOVE or recursive child is added; nine COPY ranks, paid profile and rank mass 5,129 are unchanged. Forward positive bound stays 49,347; reverse bound falls **1,113,070 → 1,031,082**; payload remains 93 bits under the inherited 104-bit cap. The local reverse positive matrix is entrywise dominated (22 strict entries).

`search.py` exhausts each fixed factor's destination-once, distinct-positive-donor class. A separately written integer subset-sum/backward Bellman verifier imports no search code and independently confirms the **16+16 class minima** over 8,192 states / 49,152 state-destination pairs. The class does not cover unrestricted XOR synthesis or arbitrary cuts/factorizations.

Reproduce with standard-library Python 3.11+:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/r439-frame519-seed02/verify.py
```

Expected: `PASS_R439_FRAME519`, `adds=42->32`, `local_ADDs=24305->24285`, `minima=16+16`, `columns=661`, `boolean_inputs=4096`, `controls=11`, `reverse_bound=1031082`, `payload_bits=93`, `no_new_kappa`.

Executed validation: exact integer factor/product maps, all 4,096 Boolean block inputs, full 661 dirty-input columns, the owning H1–H5 interface, complete exporter invoice, normal/optimized Python, byte-identical candidate regeneration, and source/certificate corruption rejections. Unchanged native legality and five/nine/eleven-stage checkers pass for **both words on 883 / 1,327 / 1,549 columns**, including **96 omitted-bridge controls and three record-corruption controls**. `native.py` reproduces the retained native certificate with C++17 and Boost headers. Source pins, exact certificates, proof of the finite search class, attribution and executed validation are included.

Base **`f567884aeb8851b6e794af1184119a3bfbe1e631`**, assignment seed **02**, bit-supplier track. Reviewed source heads: PR589 `a5afc8c6169ea61ba7c51dfd3cade02cc7b13b46`, PR799 `80e6463157cfc80b85af09e7e2f14748fe2dac60`. Only `research/r439-frame519-seed02/` is added; selected inputs and `upstream/` are unchanged. No pinned coordination issue exists, so the claim/result are recorded locally.

Overlap refreshed immediately before submission. **Aaron Wang's PR891** reports a whole-block single-write obstruction at frame 519; this construction permits realization in each of two fixed factors and supplies a witness outside that class. **Gareth Davidson's concurrent PR904**, inspected at `883a0bdf7792693e57c16be660824b57aacfbe05`, saves one forward ADD in overlapping `B[200:204]`; this result saves ten across the whole block and adds exact factor minima. No combined saving or import of pending code is claimed. **Gautam Gupta's PR844** and **Aaron Wang's PR873** provide related scheduling methods on distinct frames and are credited.

Credit eumemic (PR543/PR555), DreamingOfClouds (PR545/PR589), Dylan Crow, DaysSky, Zhihao Chen, Jeremy Kothe, Chafik Boukhalfa and the retained construction/checker lineage. Prepared by **Ross Richardson (@RossRichardson) with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance**, Apache-2.0. No independent human review is claimed.

The rank moments and selected conditional kappa **0.001661634653669567** are unchanged. Full repository/global hosting/outer assembly/selected cold replay and Lean theorem checks were not rerun; no fresh global bound is claimed. The inherited all-size/compiler, common-label/mutable-source, whole-call hosting, precision/tape and analytic assumptions remain. Remote CI is separate from the completed local checks.
title: Finite construction: R439 frame 519 saves 20 complete local ADDs (no new kappa)
